products.reason_for_recall: One code of Wylwood brand Frozen Whole Kernel Corn was found to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes based on sampling and analysis by the State of Tennessee. The firm decided to recall other labels and codes produced the same day as the suspect lot as a precaution.
